methodology_anchors.S1: Phase 1 finding: orthogonality refuted demographic buffer; Autor 2024 historical-base-rate is structurally biased — bounded above. Under post-growth, S1 mechanism requires expanding output, structurally weaker (locked spec line 92-94).
methodology_anchors.S2a: Layer 5 wage cliff −25% to −40%; certification walls 12-42 months — bounded by L5 reality, not narrative.
methodology_anchors.S2b: Climate adaptation Zone C wage-positive premium; Cedefop 2025 country-level employment projections + EU Net-Zero Industry Act €100B. Under post-growth, S2b is the only genuinely-positive scenario (locked spec line 96, 104).
methodology_anchors.S4a: Autor 2024 reinstatement weakening + Lens 5 inputs hold. Under post-growth, fiscal headroom shrinks (line 98).
methodology_anchors.S4b: Lens 5 dominates; bandwidth fractures. Under post-growth, threshold to bandwidth saturation is lower (line 99).
methodology_anchors.S5_conditional: Concurrent crises saturate bandwidth; capability floor breached. Under post-growth, fiscal headroom for institutions shrinks; threshold to cascade is lower (line 100). Empirical anchor: Ukraine.
methodology_anchors.elicitation_framework: Cooke 1991 classical-model expert elicitation; ranges align with IPCC AR6 likelihood scale (likely=66-100%, more likely than not=>50%, about as likely as not=33-66%, unlikely=0-33%).

S2b_dominance_under_post_growth.rule: P(S2b | post_growth_empirical) must be highest among 6 routine variants (locked spec line 104).

metadata.be_nl_extension_verdict: orthogonal — squeeze-flag captures jurisdictional buffering (capital-flight Mode 1 mechanism), not displacement velocity. Bundle K-2 Lens 5(c) does not show high-coord pulse for BE/NL relative to other squeeze-flag countries (BE drag 0.500, NL drag 0.478 — within Continental knowledge-economy range). No false-positive evidence; orthogonal-signal classification confirmed.
metadata.se_class_i_confidence: medium — passes (b) relative-stable rule + Bundle K-2 breach entry; Bundle H S4b ≥ 0.20 knife-edge survives as within-Class-I sensitivity band (not class boundary).
